newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast products prices stay mixed late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast products prices stay mixed late.

text.p: U.S. West Coast products prices stayed narrowly mixed late, with inventory data from the American Petroleum Institute (API) seen neutral by traders and buying expected to trickle off with refinery margins weak.
"I would think Thursday or Friday, they'll be some activity," one trader said, noting the combination of higher NYMEX crude and lagging West Coast product values were hurting margins.
Bids for Los Angeles conventional regular grade slipped a cent to 63 cents a gallon while offers fell 0.50 cent to 64 cents.
